name: clear
description: Delete the values in a range, keeping formatting. Confirm with the user first.

spreadsheet.description: Spreadsheet id, or its docs.google.com/spreadsheets URL. A URL with #gid= picks that tab.

sheet.description: Tab name. Default: the tab in the URL, else the first tab.

range.description: Cells in A1 notation, e.g. A2:D9. Required unless all_cells is true.

all_cells.description: Clear every cell of the tab instead of a range. Default false.
